name: 74133 · Tulsa, OK
findings: ZIP 74133 (Tulsa) has 227 nonprofit organizations. 84 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 75 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (39% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 74133 (Tulsa) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 74133 (Tulsa) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 74133 (Tulsa) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 75 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 23 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.
